name: Sodium alkane sulfonate
description: Sodium alkane sulfonate (CAS 68037-49-0 ) is an anionic surfactant derived from linear paraffin chains in the C10–C18 range. It delivers reliable detergency, emulsification, and foam generation across a broad range of industrial and consumer cleaning formulations. In household and industrial cleaners, it functions as the primary active detergent in dishwashing liquids, hard surface cleaners, and laundry formulations. It lifts oils and soils from surfaces effectively at moderate concentrations. Textile processors use it as a wetting and scouring agent to ensure uniform dye penetration and to remove processing oils from fiber substrates. This ensures high-quality finishes and consistent results during the manufacturing process. In the oil and gas sector, it supports emulsification in drilling fluid systems and enhanced oil recovery formulations. Its chemical stability makes it a preferred choice for demanding environmental conditions in the field. Personal care manufacturers incorporate it into shampoos and body washes where a cost-effective, foam-boosting surfactant base is required. It provides a stable lather that enhances the sensory experience for the end consumer. Sodium alkane sulfonate is supplied as an aqueous solution, typically at active concentrations of 30–60%. In some grades, it is available as a dry powder or granulate for solid formulation work and specialized applications. The Technical grade is the standard offering for industrial cleaning and process applications. Purity specifications and active content are confirmed against established industry test methods for quality assurance. Documentation is available to support formulation QA requirements and regulatory compliance.
